sources.observations: Southwest dusk photo. Tall blank west end sign panel with inset rectangular moldings; long south elevation narrow paired windows with projecting dark Juliet balcony rails, warm tan piers and cream trim. Rounded SW GIADA white fascia wraps corner across two horizontal glazed bands. Rooftop stepped back white rectilinear mass with two visible open cabana tiers at west. Wrapped dark parapet sign band. Pedestrian bridge lands above street at south side. Actual dimensions not surveyed.

Southwest oblique. Upper hotel longrectangularplan with curved SW corner; blankwestend; south paired Juliet windows. Pool terrace west half, two cabana levels along north parapet, raised curved-front enclosed roof mass east half. Southern balcony row more widely spaced than current densewindows. East oval driveway canopy. Bridges retained. Image era Cromwell/Drais, date not displayed; current2026photo confirms basicenvelope remains.

uncertainties: Rooftop elevations and east service elevations need Earth plan check
